name: jra-bot-infra
description: 運用 CLI（ops/）と GCP の資源定義（Pulumi。pulumi/）の TypeScript。jra-bot-web の docs/LANGUAGE_MIGRATION.md

scripts.build: tsc -p ops/tsconfig.json && tsc -p pulumi/tsconfig.json && tsc -p pulumi-aws/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run --silent build && npm run --silent bundle:aws && node ops/run-tests.mjs && node pulumi/run-tests.mjs && node pulumi-aws/run-tests.mjs
